{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_seo_criteria", "from_": "seo-lead@company.example.com", "to": ["marketing@company.example.com"], "subject": "SEO Audit Criteria for January", "date": "2026-01-22T00:00:00Z", "is_read": false}
消息 ID：msg_seo_criteria
来源：seo-lead@company.example.com
收件人：marketing@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-22T00:00:00Z
主题：SEO Audit Criteria for January
Hi team,

For the January audit, flag pages meeting BOTH conditions:
- CTR below 2.0%
- Impressions above 20,000

Also heads up: the /solutions page CTR in the sheet is wrong. Analytics confirmed the real CTR is 0.9% (tracking pixel was miscounted). Include /solutions in the audit.

Make sure /partners is in the report -- it's a strategic partner page. And skip /integrations, that page is being redesigned.

Audit tracking code: SEOAUDIT-441-JAN. Include this in the report.

Thanks,
Jordan"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_seo_old_criteria", "from_": "vp-marketing@company.example.com", "to": ["marketing@company.example.com"], "subject": "Q4 SEO Standards Update", "date": "2025-10-05T00:00:00Z", "is_read": true}

收件人：marketing@company.example.com
日期：2025-10-05T00:00:00Z
主题：Q4 SEO Standards Update
Team,

For Q4 audits, we're raising the bar. New standards:
- Flag pages with CTR below 5.0%
- Include ALL pages regardless of impression count
- Always include /careers in the report (hiring push)

Let's make sure every page is covered.

Best,
VP Marketing"}
